_about: Chatbot messages in isiXhosa. DRAFT TRANSLATIONS: written by the development team, not yet checked by a fluent isiXhosa speaker. Every message must be reviewed before real residents use it (see docs/LANGUAGE_REVIEW.md). Keys must match en.json exactly; a test checks this.
welcome:
Welcome to Report EC 👋
Wamkelekile ku-Report EC.

Choose a language / Khetha ulwimi:
1. English
2. isiXhosa
ask_description:
Nceda uchaze ingxaki ngamazwi akho.
Umzekelo: "Kukho umbhobho wamanzi ogqabhukileyo kufuphi nekliniki."
description_missing: Andifumananga nkcazelo. Nceda ubhale amagama ambalwa ngengxaki.
description_too_short: Nceda undixelele ngakumbi, umzekelo yintoni eyaphukileyo nokuba kwenzeka ntoni.
media_without_text: Enkosi ngomfanekiso 📷. Nceda uchaze nengxaki ngamagama.
too_long: Lo myalezo mde kakhulu. Nceda ungadluli kwiimpawu ezi-{max_chars}.
unsupported_message: Uxolo, ndifunda kuphela imiyalezo ebhaliweyo, imifanekiso kunye nendawo okuyo.
clarify_category: Andiqinisekanga ukuba luhlobo luni lwengxaki. Nceda ukhethe esona sikufutshane:
safety.electrical: ⚠️ Hlala kude neentambo uze ugcine abantwana kude. Musa ukuchukumisa nantoni na edibene nazo.
safety.open_manhole: ⚠️ Gcina abantwana kude nomngxuma ovulekileyo uze ulumkise abanye.
safety.flooding: ⚠️ Hlala kude namanzi aqukuqelayo ngamandla, kwaye ucime izixhobo zombane ezinokumanzi, ukuba kukhuselekile ukwenza oko.
safety.sewage: ⚠️ Musa ukuchukumisa amanzi elindle kwaye ugcine abantwana kude nawo.
safety.footer: Ukuba umntu wenzakele okanye usengozini ngoku, tsalela u-112 ngeselula okanye u-10177 (i-ambulensi nomlilo). Le ncoko AYIZazisi iinkonzo zongxamiseko.
safety.footer.ussd: Usengozini? Tsalela u-112. Le asiyonombolo yongxamiseko.
ask_location:
Iphi ingxaki? Thumela igama lendawo kunye nendawo eyaziwayo ekufutshane, umzekelo: "eZwide, kufuphi nekliniki".
Ungathumela nendawo okuyo 📍.
ask_location.ussd: Bhala indawo nento eyaziwayo ekufutshane, umz. Zwide kufuphi nekliniki:
location_need_area: Enkosi. Ikweyiphi indawo leyo? (umzekelo eZwide, KwaZakhele okanye eMotherwell)
location_missing: Ndisafuna ukwazi ukuba iphi ingxaki ukuze iqela liyifumane. Nceda ubhale igama lendawo okanye indawo eyaziwayo ekufutshane, okanye uthumele indawo okuyo 📍.
location_accepted_as_written: Enkosi. Ndiza kuthumela indawo njengoko uyibhalile. Abasebenzi bakamasipala basenokufuna ukuyiqinisekisa.
ask_ward: Uyayazi inombolo yewadi? Phendula ngenombolo, okanye u-0 ukuba awuyazi.
ward_invalid: Nceda uphendule ngenombolo yewadi ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-{max_ward}, okanye u-0 ukuba awuyazi.
ask_evidence: Ukuba unomfanekiso wengxaki, wuthumele ngoku. Ukuba akunawo, phendula u-0 ukutsiba.
evidence_invalid: Nceda uthumele umfanekiso, okanye uphendule u-0 ukutsiba.
evidence_unsupported_type: Uxolo, ndamkela kuphela imifanekiso (JPEG, PNG okanye WEBP). Nceda uthumele umfanekiso, okanye uphendule u-0 ukutsiba.
submitted:
✅ Ingxelo yakho ithunyelwe ku-Report EC.
Inombolo yesalathiso: *{reference}*
Gcina le nombolo ukuze ulandele inkqubela. Bhala *imenyu* ukubona ezinye iindlela.
submitted.ussd: Ingxelo ithunyelwe. Isalathiso: {reference}. Gcina le nombolo.
already_submitted:
Le ngxelo sele ithunyelwe. Inombolo yesalathiso: *{reference}*
Bhala *imenyu* ukubona ezinye iindlela.
submission_failed: ❌ Uxolo, asikwazanga ukuthumela ingxelo yakho ngoku. AYITHUNYELWANGA kwaye akukabikho nombolo yesalathiso. Iinkcukacha zakho zisagciniwe.
cancelled: Ingxelo yakho irhoxisiwe kwaye akukho nto ithunyelweyo. Thumela nawuphi na umyalezo ukuze uqale kwakhona.
help:
Uncedo lwe-Report EC:
• *imenyu* – imenyu ephambili
• *emva* – inyathelo elidlulileyo
• *rhoxisa* – yeka ingxelo yangoku
• *qala* – qala kwakhona
• *ulwimi* – tshintsha ulwimi

I-Report EC ithumela ingxelo yakho kumasipala. Ayiyonkonzo yongxamiseko. Kwimeko yongxamiseko, tsalela u-112 ngeselula.
help.ussd: I-Report EC ithumela iingxelo kumasipala. Ayiyonkonzo yongxamiseko: tsalela u-112.
invalid_choice: Uxolo, andikuqondanga. Nceda uphendule ngenye yeenombolo eziboniswayo.
invalid_choice_repeated: Kubonakala ngathi eli nyathelo linzima. Ungabhala *uncedo* nangaliphi na ixesha, okanye *imenyu* ukuqala kwakhona.
ask_reference_with_last: Nceda uthumele inombolo yesalathiso. Ingxelo yakho yokugqibela ibingu-*{reference}*: phendula u-1 ukuyijonga.
reference_invalid: Le ayibonakali njengenombolo yesalathiso. Ifana no-EC-1042. Nceda uzame kwakhona, okanye ubhale *imenyu*.
status_not_found: Andifumananga ngxelo enale nombolo enxulumene nale nombolo yefowuni. Nceda ujonge inombolo uzame kwakhona.
status_unavailable: Uxolo, andikwazi ukujonga imeko ngoku. Nceda uzame kwakhona emva kwexesha.
status_verify_hint: Ungasixelela ukuba ilungisiwe ngenene: khetha *Ukuqinisekisa okanye ukuphikisa ukulungiswa* kwimenyu.

status.acknowledged.label: Yamkelwe

status.pending_verification.explain: Umasipala uthi ingxaki ilungisiwe. Ayivalwa de abahlali bayiqinisekise.
status.verified_resolved.label: Iqinisekisiwe ukuba ilungisiwe
status.verified_resolved.explain: Ukulungiswa kuhlolwe ngenkqubo yokuqinisekisa kwaye ingxelo ivaliwe.
status.disputed.label: Iyaphikiswa
status.disputed.explain: Abahlali bathi ingxaki ayilungiswanga. Umasipala kufuneka ayiphonononge kwakhona.

status.reopened.explain: Ingxelo ivulwe kwakhona kuba ingxaki ayilungiswanga okanye ibuyile.
status.unknown.label: Ayaziwa
status.unknown.explain: Imeko ayikwazanga ukuchazwa. Nceda uqhagamshelane nomasipala.
verify.ask_reference: Yeyiphi ingxelo ofuna ukuyiqinisekisa okanye ukuyiphikisa? Nceda uthumele inombolo yesalathiso (umzekelo EC-1042).

verify.recorded: Enkosi. Impendulo yakho ibhaliwe kwingxelo {reference}. Iza kuhlolwa kunye neempendulo zabanye abahlali phambi kokuba kwenziwe isigqibo sokugqibela. Lo myalezo awuyivali ingxelo.
verify.recorded.ussd: Enkosi. Impendulo yakho ye-{reference} ibhaliwe ukuze ihlolwe.
verify.failed: ❌ Uxolo, asikwazanga ukubhala impendulo yakho ngoku. AYIGCINWANGA.
